textoCompleto:
Rancho Los Amigos Scale

BRAIN INJURY ASSESSMENT

Assesses the cognitive and behavioral patterns of patients during recovery from Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI).
Patient Data

Fill out for Medical Record/PDF Report

Cognitive Level Assessment
Rancho Los Amigos Level

Assessment Memory

Exemplifying with NANDA: NANDA diagnoses related to the identified problems (Educational purpose)
Based on the patient's cognitive and behavioral response.

Processing clinical reasoning...

A NANDA diagnosis requires a careful evaluation of its taxonomies and the search for defining characteristics and related factors. The disclosure of diagnoses on this scale serves only an educational purpose, to promote its use and help users become familiar with the various diagnoses. Under no circumstances should it induce the user to indiscriminately apply any nursing diagnosis without the support of clinical findings obtained through history taking, physical examination, and other systematic tools that will guide the nurse in prescribing care.

Frequently Asked Questions
Follow more nursing information on our nursing forum.

Related Scales
Glasgow Scale Assessment of neurological consciousness level.

Jouvet Scale Assesses levels of coma and reactivity.

FOUR Scale Advanced neurological assessment.

Scientific Reference
RANCHO LOS AMIGOS National Rehabilitation Center. Rancho Los Amigos Levels of Cognitive Functioning Scale. Rancho Research Institute , 2021.

Score Interpretation

Levels I to III
Total Assistance: Coma to localized responses. Focus on basic support, positioning, and slow sensory stimulation.

Levels IV and V
Maximum Assistance: Confusion, agitation, and inappropriate responses. Injury prevention and simple communication.

Level VI
Moderate Assistance: Confused but appropriate. Able to follow commands, promote independence in family routines.

Levels VII and VIII
Minimal Supervision: Appropriate and automatic to directed. Reintegration into the community and judgment training.
